blind.description: A traditional five-light metal candelabra featuring a round tiered pedestal base, a turned central stem, and curved branching arms supporting candle cups. Five cream-colored wax candles with exposed dark wicks rest in the holders, with one in the center and two branching out to each side. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and well-modeled in an antiqued bronze/brass finish with no visible flames.
blind.from_above: A circular stepped metal base with a central circular candle top, flanked on opposite sides by branched arms holding two pairs of round candles, showing five candle wicks in total.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 feet tall (roughly one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.2 feet wide across the candle arms.
